```{r run_simulations, cache=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS — Variable Importance
# Outcomes  : logit(AR_total), logit(AR_vol), logit(AR_staff)
# Parameters: R0, k, k_sus, k_ct, ct.rates, mean_e, mean_i
# ============================================================

source("C:\\Users\\Chau\\Downloads\\F\\Statistics UHasselt\\Semester 4\\Master Thesis\\Master-Thesis---Chau-\\SEIR_contact-rates.R")

library(lhs)
library(randomForest)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================
# Fixed Setting
# ============================================================
n       <- 28
nSeeds  <- 1
t.stop  <- 360
nRep    <- 20
n_SA    <- 500

roles_baseline <- rep("vol", n)
roles          <- c(rep("vol", 24), rep("staff", 4))

sc2_assign <- c(rep(1, 12), rep(2, 12), rep(3, 4))
M_bridge <- matrix(c(
  0.90, 0.00, 0.10,
  0.00, 0.90, 0.10,
  0.40, 0.40, 0.20
), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

sc34_assign <- c(rep(1, 12), rep(2, 12), rep(3, 2), rep(4, 2))
M_strict <- matrix(c(
  0.90, 0.00, 0.10, 0.00,
  0.00, 0.90, 0.00, 0.10,
  0.50, 0.00, 0.50, 0.00,
  0.00, 0.50, 0.00, 0.50
), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)

M_common <- matrix(c(
  0.90, 0.00, 0.10, 0.00,
  0.00, 0.90, 0.00, 0.10,
  0.45, 0.00, 0.45, 0.10,
  0.00, 0.45, 0.10, 0.45
), nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE)

scenarios <- c("sc1", "sc2", "sc3", "sc4")
sc_labels <- c(sc1 = "Free Mixing",
               sc2 = "Staff-Bridge",
               sc3 = "Strict Cohorting",
               sc4 = "Common Staff Room")

# ============================================================
# Latin Hypercube Sampling
# ============================================================
set.seed(01042026)

lhs_matrix <- randomLHS(n_SA, 7)

input_params <- data.frame(
  R0       = 1.5 + lhs_matrix[, 1] * (4.0 - 1.5),
  ct.rates = 1.0 + lhs_matrix[, 2] * (6.0 - 1.0),
  k        = 0.1 + lhs_matrix[, 3] * (1.0 - 0.1),
  k_ct     = 0.5 + lhs_matrix[, 4] * (1.5 - 0.5),
  k_sus    = 0.5 + lhs_matrix[, 5] * (1.5 - 0.5),
  mean_e   = 3.0 + lhs_matrix[, 6] * (7.0 - 3.0),
  mean_i   = 5.0 + lhs_matrix[, 7] * (12.0 - 5.0)
)

param_names <- names(input_params)
cat("LHS sampling done. Parameter ranges:\n")
print(sapply(input_params, range))

# ============================================================
# Helper Function
# ============================================================
logit <- function(p) log(p / (1 - p))

compute_AR <- function(sim_result, n_vol = 24, n_staff = 4) {
  sm  <- sim_result$status.matrix
  inf <- !is.na(sm$time.of.infection)
  eps <- 1e-3
  AR_total <- pmin(pmax(max(sum(inf) - nSeeds, 0) / (n - nSeeds), eps), 1 - eps)
  AR_vol   <- pmin(pmax(sum(inf & sm$roles == "vol")   / n_vol,   eps), 1 - eps)
  AR_staff <- pmin(pmax(sum(inf & sm$roles == "staff") / n_staff, eps), 1 - eps)
  return(c(AR_total = AR_total, AR_vol = AR_vol, AR_staff = AR_staff))
}

run_one_sim <- function(p, sc_id) {
  switch(sc_id,
    "sc1" = sim.epi_seir(
      n = n, ct.rates = p$ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
      R0 = p$R0, t.stop = t.stop,
      roles = roles_baseline, average_mod = average_mod,
      k = p$k, k_sus = p$k_sus, k_ct = p$k_ct,
      mean_e = p$mean_e, sd_e = 2.8,
      mean_i = p$mean_i, sd_i = 3.8),
    "sc2" = sim.epi_seir(
      n = n, ct.rates = p$ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
      R0 = p$R0, t.stop = t.stop,
      roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod,
      k = p$k, k_sus = p$k_sus, k_ct = p$k_ct,
      mean_e = p$mean_e, sd_e = 2.8,
      mean_i = p$mean_i, sd_i = 3.8,
      group_assign = sc2_assign, M = M_bridge),
    "sc3" = sim.epi_seir(
      n = n, ct.rates = p$ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
      R0 = p$R0, t.stop = t.stop,
      roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod,
      k = p$k, k_sus = p$k_sus, k_ct = p$k_ct,
      mean_e = p$mean_e, sd_e = 2.8,
      mean_i = p$mean_i, sd_i = 3.8,
      group_assign = sc34_assign, M = M_strict),
    "sc4" = sim.epi_seir(
      n = n, ct.rates = p$ct.rates, nSeeds = nSeeds,
      R0 = p$R0, t.stop = t.stop,
      roles = roles, average_mod = average_mod,
      k = p$k, k_sus = p$k_sus, k_ct = p$k_ct,
      mean_e = p$mean_e, sd_e = 2.8,
      mean_i = p$mean_i, sd_i = 3.8,
      group_assign = sc34_assign, M = M_common)
  )
}

# ============================================================
# Run Simulations
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Sanity check (1 sim) ---\n")
sim_test <- run_one_sim(input_params[1, ], "sc1")
ar_test  <- compute_AR(sim_test)
cat("AR values  :", round(ar_test, 4), "\n")
cat("logit(AR)  :", round(logit(ar_test), 4), "\n")
cat("----------------------------\n\n")

all_results <- list()

for (sc in scenarios) {
  cat("\n=== Scenario:", sc_labels[sc], "===\n")

  res <- input_params
  res$logitAR_total <- NA_real_
  res$logitAR_vol   <- NA_real_
  res$logitAR_staff <- NA_real_

  for (i in 1:n_SA) {
    if (i %% 100 == 0) cat("  LHS run:", i, "/", n_SA, "\n")

    p <- input_params[i, ]
    ar_total_vec <- numeric(nRep)
    ar_vol_vec   <- numeric(nRep)
    ar_staff_vec <- numeric(nRep)

    for (r in 1:nRep) {
      sim_r  <- run_one_sim(p, sc)
      ar_vec <- compute_AR(sim_r)
      ar_total_vec[r] <- ar_vec["AR_total"]
      ar_vol_vec[r]   <- ar_vec["AR_vol"]
      ar_staff_vec[r] <- ar_vec["AR_staff"]
    }

    res$logitAR_total[i] <- logit(mean(ar_total_vec))
    res$logitAR_vol[i]   <- logit(mean(ar_vol_vec))
    res$logitAR_staff[i] <- logit(mean(ar_staff_vec))
  }

  na_n <- sum(is.na(res$logitAR_total))
  cat("  Done. NAs:", na_n, "\n")
  all_results[[sc]] <- res
}

saveRDS(all_results, "sensitivity_all_scenarios.rds")
cat("\nAll simulations done. Results saved.\n")
```



```{r rf_importance, cache=TRUE, dependson="run_simulations"}
# ============================================================
# Random Forest Variable Importance
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- Fitting RF ---\n")

param_labels <- c(
  R0       = "R0",
  k        = "k",
  k_sus    = "k_sus",
  k_ct     = "k_ct",
  ct.rates = "ct.rates",
  mean_e   = "mean_e",
  mean_i   = "mean_i"
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  logitAR_total = "AR Total",
  logitAR_vol   = "AR Volunteers",
  logitAR_staff = "AR Staff"
)

imp_list1 <- list()
rf_models  <- list()   

for (sc in scenarios) {
  df <- all_results[[sc]]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df[, c("logitAR_total",
                                  "logitAR_vol",
                                  "logitAR_staff")]), ]
  cat("Scenario:", sc_labels[sc],
      "| rows after NA removal:", nrow(df), "\n")

  rf_models[[sc]] <- list()

  for (out in names(outcome_labels)) {
    rf <- suppressWarnings(
      randomForest(
        x          = df[, param_names],
        y          = df[[out]],
        ntree      = 500,
        importance = TRUE
      )
    )
    cat("  ", outcome_labels[out],
        "| R2:", round(tail(rf$rsq, 1), 3), "\n")

    # Save importance
    imp <- importance(rf, type = 1)
    imp_list1[[paste(sc, out, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      parameter  = rownames(imp),
      importance = imp[, "%IncMSE"],
      scenario   = sc_labels[sc],
      outcome    = outcome_labels[out],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      row.names  = NULL
    )

    # Save rf_model for PDP
    out_short <- switch(out,
      logitAR_total = "total",
      logitAR_vol   = "vol",
      logitAR_staff = "staff")
    rf_models[[sc]][[out_short]] <- rf
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Variable Importance Plot
# ============================================================
imp_df1 <- bind_rows(imp_list1)
imp_df1$param_label <- factor(param_labels[imp_df1$parameter],
                               levels = rev(param_labels))
imp_df1$scenario    <- factor(imp_df1$scenario, levels = sc_labels)
imp_df1$outcome     <- factor(imp_df1$outcome,
                               levels = c("AR Total",
                                          "AR Volunteers",
                                          "AR Staff"))

p1 <- ggplot(imp_df1,
             aes(x = importance, y = param_label, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "#CC79A7"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Variable Importance per scenario",
    subtitle = "Random Forest (permutation importance) | logit(AR)",
    x        = "% increase in MSE",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p1)
ggsave("SA_approach1_per_scenario.png", p1,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_approach1_per_scenario.png\n")

# ============================================================
# R-Squared Summary Table
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- R-squared summary ---\n")

r2_rows <- list()
for (sc in scenarios) {
  for (out in names(outcome_labels)) {
    r2_rows[[length(r2_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Scenario = sc_labels[sc],
      Outcome  = outcome_labels[out],
      R2       = round(tail(rf_models[[sc]][[
        switch(out,
          logitAR_total = "total",
          logitAR_vol   = "vol",
          logitAR_staff = "staff")
      ]]$rsq, 1), 3)
    )
  }
}

r2_table <- bind_rows(r2_rows)
print(r2_table)
write.csv(r2_table, "SA_R2_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== RF done! Output files: ===\n")
cat("  sensitivity_all_scenarios.rds\n")
cat("  SA_approach1_per_scenario.png\n")
cat("  SA_R2_summary.csv\n")
cat("  rf_models\n")

# ============================================================
# Out-of-Bag Error (OOB Error) Summary
# ============================================================
cat("\n--- OOB Error summary ---\n")

oob_rows <- list()
for (sc in scenarios) {
  for (out_short in c("total", "vol", "staff")) {
    rf  <- rf_models[[sc]][[out_short]]
    out_label <- switch(out_short,
      total = "AR Total",
      vol   = "AR Volunteers",
      staff = "AR Staff")

    # OOB MSE = last value of rf$mse
    # OOB R^2  = last value of rf$rsq (same as R^2 table)
    oob_mse <- tail(rf$mse, 1)
    oob_r2  <- tail(rf$rsq, 1)

    oob_rows[[length(oob_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Scenario = sc_labels[sc],
      Outcome  = out_label,
      OOB_MSE  = round(oob_mse, 4),
      OOB_R2   = round(oob_r2,  3)
    )
  }
}

oob_table <- bind_rows(oob_rows)
print(oob_table)
write.csv(oob_table, "SA_OOB_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: SA_OOB_summary.csv\n")

```


```{r rf_univariate, cache=TRUE, dependson="run_simulations"}
# ============================================================
# UNIVARIATE RF — separate model per parameter (theo thầy)
# Dùng lại all_results từ chunk run_simulations
# ============================================================

imp_univariate <- list()

for (sc in scenarios) {
  df <- all_results[[sc]]
  df <- df[complete.cases(
    df[, c("logitAR_total","logitAR_vol","logitAR_staff")]), ]
  cat("Scenario:", sc_labels[sc], "\n")

  for (out in names(outcome_labels)) {
    for (param in param_names) {

      rf_uni <- suppressWarnings(
        randomForest(
          x     = df[, param, drop = FALSE],
          y     = df[[out]],
          ntree = 500
        )
      )

      imp_univariate[[paste(sc, out, param, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
        parameter = param,
        R2        = round(tail(rf_uni$rsq, 1), 3),
        OOB_MSE   = round(tail(rf_uni$mse, 1), 4),
        scenario  = sc_labels[sc],
        outcome   = outcome_labels[out],
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

imp_uni_df <- bind_rows(imp_univariate)
imp_uni_df$parameter <- factor(imp_uni_df$parameter,
                                levels = rev(param_names))
imp_uni_df$scenario  <- factor(imp_uni_df$scenario,
                                levels = sc_labels)
imp_uni_df$outcome   <- factor(imp_uni_df$outcome,
                                levels = c("AR Total",
                                           "AR Volunteers",
                                           "AR Staff"))

# Plot
p_uni <- ggplot(imp_uni_df,
                aes(x = R2, y = parameter, fill = scenario)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "#CC79A7"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Variable Importance: Univariate RF",
    subtitle = "Separate RF model per parameter | R² on logit(AR)",
    x        = "R² (univariate RF)",
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"))

print(p_uni)
ggsave("SA_univariate_RF.png", p_uni,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Summary table
cat("\n=== Univariate RF R² Summary ===\n")
imp_uni_df %>%
  filter(outcome == "AR Total") %>%
  arrange(scenario, desc(R2)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  print()

write.csv(imp_uni_df, "SA_univariate_RF.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: SA_univariate_RF.png\n")
cat("Saved: SA_univariate_RF.csv\n")
```

```{r prcc, dependson="run_simulations"}
# =========================================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS - Partial Rank Correlation Coefficient
# =========================================================================
library(sensitivity)  
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# =========================================================================
# Compute PRCC — per scenario × per outcome
# =========================================================================
# pcc() with rank=TRUE → PRCC: estimate + 95% CI + p-value

prcc_list <- list()

for (sc in names(all_results)) {
  df <- all_results[[sc]]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df[, c("logitAR_total",
                                  "logitAR_vol",
                                  "logitAR_staff")]), ]

  cat("Scenario:", sc_labels[sc], "| n =", nrow(df), "\n")

  for (out in names(outcome_labels)) {
    prcc_res <- pcc(
      X    = df[, param_names],
      y    = df[[out]],
      rank = TRUE,      # PRCC (rank-based) — robust to non-linearity
      conf = 0.95, 
      nboot = 100 
    )

    # Extract results
    est <- prcc_res$PRCC
    cat("  Columns:", names(est), "\n")
    
    df_prcc <- data.frame(
      parameter   = rownames(est),
      prcc        = est[, "original"],
      ci_low      = est[, "min. c.i."],
      ci_high     = est[, "max. c.i."],
      scenario    = sc_labels[sc],
      outcome     = outcome_labels[out],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
      row.names   = NULL
    )

    # p-value: PRCC significant if CI doesn't cross 0
    df_prcc$significant <- !(df_prcc$ci_low < 0 & df_prcc$ci_high > 0)

    prcc_list[[paste(sc, out, sep = "_")]] <- df_prcc
    cat("  ", outcome_labels[out], "done\n")
  }
}

prcc_df <- bind_rows(prcc_list)
prcc_df$param_label <- factor(param_labels[prcc_df$parameter],
                               levels = rev(param_labels))
prcc_df$scenario    <- factor(prcc_df$scenario, levels = sc_labels)
prcc_df$outcome     <- factor(prcc_df$outcome,
                               levels = c("AR Total",
                                          "AR Volunteers",
                                          "AR Staff"))

# =========================================================================
# Print Summary Table
# =========================================================================
cat("\n=== PRCC Summary (all scenarios) ===\n")

prcc_summary <- prcc_df %>%
  mutate(
    prcc    = round(prcc,    3),
    ci_low  = round(ci_low,  3),
    ci_high = round(ci_high, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(scenario, outcome, parameter,
         prcc, ci_low, ci_high, significant) %>%
  arrange(scenario, outcome, desc(abs(prcc)))

# Print each scenario
for (sc_name in unique(prcc_summary$scenario)) {
  cat("\n---", sc_name, "---\n")
  prcc_summary %>%
    filter(scenario == sc_name) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%   
    print()
}

# =========================================================================
# Plot PRCC per scenario (facet = outcome, color = scenario)
# =========================================================================
# Only show CI bar if significant
prcc_df$alpha_val <- ifelse(prcc_df$significant, 1.0, 0.35)

p_prcc1 <- ggplot(prcc_df,
                  aes(x = prcc, y = param_label,
                      color = scenario, alpha = significant)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.2, 0.2),
             linetype = "dotted", color = "grey70") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                 height = 0.25,
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_point(size = 3,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "#CC79A7"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.3),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
  limits = c(-0.3, 0.9),       
  breaks = seq(-0.2, 0.8, 0.2), 
  labels = c("-0.2", "0", "0.2", "0.4", "0.6", "0.8")
) +
  labs(
    title    = "PRCC: Partial Rank Correlation Coefficients",
    subtitle = paste0("95% CI shown | Faded = non-significant (CI crosses 0)"),
    x = "PRCC",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
  )

print(p_prcc1)
ggsave("SA_PRCC_per_scenario.png", p_prcc1,
       width = 13, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_PRCC_per_scenario.png\n")

# =========================================================================
# Plot Focus on top variables — R0 and k only
# =========================================================================
prcc_top <- prcc_df %>%
  filter(parameter %in% c("R0", "k"))

p_prcc_top <- ggplot(prcc_top,
                     aes(x = scenario, y = prcc,
                         fill = scenario, alpha = significant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                width = 0.25, color = "grey30") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  facet_grid(parameter ~ outcome) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "#CC79A7"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1.0, "FALSE" = 0.3),
                     guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-1, 1),
                     breaks = seq(-1, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(
    title    = "PRCC: Top Variables (R0 and k) by Scenario and Outcome",
    subtitle = "Error bars = 95% CI | Faded = non-significant",
    x = NULL, y = "PRCC"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
  )

print(p_prcc_top)
ggsave("SA_PRCC_top_variables.png", p_prcc_top,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_PRCC_top_variables.png\n")

# =========================================================================
# Comparison table: RF vs PRCC
# =========================================================================
cat("\n=== RF vs PRCC Comparison (Free Mixing, AR Total) ===\n")
cat("Checks if both methods agree on variable ranking\n\n")

# PRCC ranking for sc1, AR Total
prcc_sc1 <- prcc_df %>%
  filter(scenario == "Free Mixing", outcome == "AR Total") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(prcc))) %>%
  mutate(PRCC_rank = row_number()) %>%
  select(parameter, prcc, significant, PRCC_rank)

cat("PRCC ranking:\n")
print(prcc_sc1)

cat("\nIf R0 and k are top-ranked in both RF and PRCC → findings are ROBUST\n")

# =========================================================================
# Save full PRCC table
# =========================================================================
write.csv(
  prcc_df %>%
    mutate(across(c(prcc, ci_low, ci_high), ~ round(.x, 4))) %>%
    select(scenario, outcome, parameter,
           prcc, ci_low, ci_high, significant),
  "SA_PRCC_full_table.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\n=== PRCC Analysis Done! ===\n")
cat("Output files:\n")
cat("  SA_PRCC_per_scenario.png\n")
cat("  SA_PRCC_top_variables.png\n")
cat("  SA_PRCC_full_table.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# =========================================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: Partial Dependence Plots (PDP)
# =========================================================================
library(pdp)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute PDP for R0 and k — all 4 scenarios
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
outcomes     <- c("total", "vol", "staff")
outcome_labs <- c(total = "AR Total",
                  vol   = "AR Volunteers",
                  staff = "AR Staff")

pdp_list <- list()

for (sc in scenarios) {
  df <- all_results[[sc]]
  df <- df[complete.cases(df[, c("logitAR_total",
                                  "logitAR_vol",
                                  "logitAR_staff")]), ]
  for (out in outcomes) {
    for (var in c("R0", "k")) {
      pdp_res <- partial(
        object   = rf_models[[sc]][[out]],
        pred.var = var,
        train    = df[, param_names],
        grid.resolution = 30  
      )
      pdp_list[[paste(sc, out, var, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
        x        = pdp_res[[var]],
        yhat     = pdp_res$yhat,
        scenario = sc_labels[sc],
        outcome  = outcome_labs[out],
        variable = var
      )
    }
  }
}

pdp_df <- bind_rows(pdp_list)
pdp_df$scenario <- factor(pdp_df$scenario, levels = sc_labels)
pdp_df$outcome  <- factor(pdp_df$outcome,
                           levels = c("AR Total",
                                      "AR Volunteers",
                                      "AR Staff"))

y_range <- pdp_df %>%
  filter(!(scenario == "Free Mixing" & outcome == "AR Staff")) %>%
  summarise(ymin = floor(min(yhat) * 10) / 10 - 0.2,
            ymax = ceiling(max(yhat) * 10) / 10 + 0.2)

y_lo <- y_range$ymin  
y_hi <- y_range$ymax

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot PDP R0 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
pdp_R0 <- pdp_df %>% filter(variable == "R0")

pdp_R0_plot <- pdp_R0 %>%
  filter(!(scenario == "Free Mixing" & outcome == "AR Staff"))

p_pdp_R0 <- ggplot(pdp_R0_plot,
                   aes(x = x, y = yhat,
                       color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "purple"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Partial Dependence Plot: R0 vs logit(AR)",
    subtitle = "Marginal effect of R0 averaged over all other parameters | 4 scenarios",
    x        = "Basic reproduction number (R0)",
    y        = "logit(AR) — partial dependence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
  )

print(p_pdp_R0)
ggsave("SA_PDP_R0.png", p_pdp_R0, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_PDP_R0.png\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot PDP k 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
pdp_k <- pdp_df %>% filter(variable == "k")

pdp_k_plot <- pdp_k %>%
  filter(!(scenario == "Free Mixing" & outcome == "AR Staff"))

p_pdp_k <- ggplot(pdp_k_plot,
                  aes(x = x, y = yhat,
                      color = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_lo, y_hi)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Free Mixing"       = "#0072B2",
               "Staff-Bridge"      = "#D55E00",
               "Strict Cohorting"  = "#009E73",
               "Common Staff Room" = "purple"),
    name = "Scenario"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Partial Dependence Plot: k vs logit(AR)",
    subtitle = "Marginal effect of infectiousness heterogeneity (k) | 4 scenarios",
    x        = "Infectiousness heterogeneity (k)",
    y        = "logit(AR) — partial dependence"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9)
  )

print(p_pdp_k)
ggsave("SA_PDP_k.png", p_pdp_k, width = 12, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_PDP_k.png\n")

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot PDP R0 × k interaction (Free Mixing only)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
pdp_2d <- partial(
  object   = rf_models[["sc1"]][["total"]],
  pred.var = c("R0", "k"),
  train    = all_results[["sc1"]][, param_names],
  grid.resolution = 20
)

p_pdp_2d <- autoplot(pdp_2d, contour = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("#313695", "#74ADD1", "#FEE090",
               "#F46D43", "#A50026"),
    name   = "logit(AR)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "2D Partial Dependence: R0 × k Interaction",
    subtitle = "Free Mixing | AR Total | Darker red = higher logit(AR)",
    x        = "Basic reproduction number (R0)",
    y        = "Infectiousness heterogeneity (k)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 9))

print(p_pdp_2d)
ggsave("SA_PDP_R0xk_2D.png", p_pdp_2d,
       width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
cat("Saved: SA_PDP_R0xk_2D.png\n")

cat("\n=== PDP Done! ===\n")
cat("  SA_PDP_R0.png\n")
cat("  SA_PDP_k.png\n")
cat("  SA_PDP_R0xk_2D.png\n")
```
